patent_grounding.rationale: Inspected cited patent passages support the modeled piston/rod and diaphragm assembly, pumped-medium suction/discharge route, bellows-enclosed spaces and cylinder-opening communication, reaction-space hydraulic linkage, curvature behavior, and claim-derived requirements/notes. Drive-medium supply is explicitly described as unmodeled rather than asserted as an implemented connection.

functional_completeness.rationale: The model includes pump housing/cylinder, drive, paired diaphragms, reaction spaces, bellows, pumping passages/valves, linkage conduit, and pumped-medium source and destination. It preserves the two distinct media systems and represents the reciprocating and hydraulic-support actions. No unsupported controller is added.

flow_consistency.rationale: All remaining interfaces join distinct subsystems with compatible descriptive flow types: pumped fluid across suction/discharge and diaphragm pressure spaces, pressurized medium between bellows spaces and piston pressure spaces, and hydraulic fluid between reaction spaces and the linkage conduit. The four previously self-mated pumping interfaces are absent. ACTUATION_PRESSURE lacks an external source connection, but the model explicitly marks that supply as unmodeled.

claim_traceability.rationale: Requirements and flow notes retain claim references and reflect supported curvature and sealing obligations; claim 2's pressure condition is confined to hydraulic linkage fluid. The pulsation statement is appropriately limited to the flow notes.

interfaces.rationale: Revision 5 removes the four self-mated interfaces formerly at /subsystems/5/interfaces/6 through /subsystems/5/interfaces/9. Remaining interfaces mate different existing subsystems and refer to existing compatible ports/flows; each connection is represented once.

textbook_application.rationale: External pumped-fluid source/sink are separately modeled, distinct flows/media are maintained, and physical decomposition/action allocation is used as modeling guidance rather than patent evidence. The unmodeled actuation source is transparently qualified.

summary: Revision 5 resolves the prior self-mated-interface defect: the four invalid PUMPING_PORTS self-connections have been removed while the external source/sink and diaphragm-connected legs remain. Independent inspection found no unresolved patent-grounding, completeness, flow, claim-traceability, interface, or textbook-application issue. No new finding is raised.
